text:
Before you switch on booking in your Facebook lead ads, look at your calendar like a customer would.

Any times free in the next few days?
Clear names like "Free 15 minute phone quote"?
Does it land in the diary your team actually checks?

People book what's easy.

Google itself says AI Max won't be effective for campaigns limited by budget.

That's most local businesses I talk to.

A tradie in Joondalup spending a few hundred dollars a week can't afford to let Google experiment with his money.

https://gimsresults.com.au/post/google-ads-ai-max-check-your-account

Your own website could be why Google changed your hours.

Google may publish a suggested edit if other public info backs it up.

If your site still says you close at 3pm Saturdays from three years ago, you've handed Google the evidence.

Make them match.

A booking calendar after your Facebook lead form doesn't replace follow-up.

Some people book straight away.
Some won't.

The ones who don't still need a quick call. Ideally within the hour.

Christmas is coming. Before your holiday hours go in, check your Google Business Profile.

Search your business name on your phone. Hours, phone number, website link, photos.

That's when hours change most, and when a wrong one costs most.

https://gimsresults.com.au/post/google-business-profile-suggested-edits

Google wants you to spend.
You want the phone to ring.

Sometimes those line up. Sometimes they don't.

The businesses doing well with Google Ads aren't the ones spending the most. They're the ones checking their account every week.
